text: Maya Chen: quick heads-up nightly scan found 8 broken anchors in docs/guides/secops/incident-checklist.md affecting localized pages (es, ja). Not urgent but translators report missing anchors in the localized mirrors. Oliver P: thanks for the ping. Do you have the scan lines? link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-24T04:05Z - 8 dead anchors detected in docs/guides/secops/incident-checklist.md; examples: #notify-slack, #evacuate-node; full report: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/3301234567 Maya Chen: I refactored headings last week to improve readability and unintentionally removed some anchor ids. I can backfill HTML anchor aliases to avoid churn in translations. i18n-bot: NOTE: translations team prefers anchor aliases instead of visible heading renames to minimize retranslation. Filing a ticket: https://internal-issues.redwood/i18n/7891 Oliver P: plan sounds good. If you add above the new "Notify Slack" heading that preserves old links. Also update any internal permalinks that point to the old anchors. Maya Chen: will do. Quick local commands I used to find instances: ```bash rg "#notify-slack|#evacuate-node" -n docs/ && \ # add anchors manually in the file above headings ``` Oliver P: small ask for the PR body: include the scan link and mention languages affected so i18n can skip retranslate. Also tag @docs-oncall for merge if CI is green. Maya Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/8342 adds anchor aliases for legacy anchors, updates 3 internal permalinks, and includes changelog note: "docs: restore legacy anchors to avoid breaking localized permalinks". Tagging @Oliver P and @docs-oncall. Oliver P: reviewing now. tiny nit: keep the exact anchor ids (case-sensitive) so external bookmarks keep working. Maya Chen: confirmed ids unchanged. Added a short comment above each alias to explain why it exists. docs-oncall: FYI if CI passes and it's only anchor comments + small link tweaks we can merge to get staging healthy before the next scan. link-scan-bot: awaiting PR merge to re-scan. Maya Chen: CI passed. Requesting merge. docs-oncall: merging now, will trigger re-scan and notify if anything else found. link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled post-merge. Maya Chen: thanks team will follow up if localized mirrors still report missing anchors.
